extraction.Name: William Emery
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded February 14, 1922, by F. C. O'Hallern
extraction.Buyer: James E. and Josephine Emery conveyed this land to Adolph Stamer and Ida Stamer for $2575.00
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612813 issued; Lots 6 and 7 and East half of the Southwest quarter of section 6, township 97, range 69; receipt for patent was signed by the allottee February 14, 1918; conveyance dated September 16, 1922; the records do not show that William transferred this land to James and Josephine
